notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Game Improvements
notes.content:
First Patch Update for Award-Winning Coalescence!

Moniker Labs invites you to return and experience brand new quality of life updates, including:

- Improvements to Relationship Tracking, Journal Entries, and Collectables 
- General Syntax and Grammar Edits
- Title Font Adjusted for Legibility 
- Main Menu Overhaul 
- New Animations
- Minor Bug Fixes
- SFX Update
- New Music

Return to Moniker Labs today and uncover their secrets once and for all!
